response.rationale: The item is defective (defective == True) and not final sale (final_sale == False), so RET-020 applies (priority 90), the highest-priority applicable rule, making the item eligible for return regardless of the standard window. RET-012 does not apply since final_sale is False, and RET-051/RET-050 do not apply since fraud_hold and goodwill_grant are False.
